description: Pittston, PA — The Rob Bresnahan for Congress campaign today announced the endorsement of the Hazleton City Firefighters, International Association of Fire Fighters (IAFF) Local 507, in Congressman Rob Bresnahan's reelection bid in Pennsylvania's 8th Congressional District.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Congressman Rob Bresnahan Earns Endorsement of Hazleton City Firefighters IAFF Local 507 - Rob for PA
